title: cstar-mbj: machine-learned Tran-Blaha mBJ exchange parameter for near-experimental band gaps
description: Dataset (116 materials, 100 clean; every experimental gap traced to a published source and every mBJ probe verified to be converged), the Materials-Project structures used, trained model (random forest + Gaussian process), prediction tool, convergence checker, and automated pipeline for predicting the material-specific optimal TB-mBJ parameter c* from inexpensive descriptors, so that a single meta-GGA calculation yields a near-experimental band gap.
